system.longDesc: You can psychically sense things outside the range and ability of the ordinary five senses.
system.requirement: Power talent: Willpower (Extrasensory Perception (ESP)) power focus at Expert

degree1.desc: You gain one Expert-degree ESP effect. You also gain the power focus Willpower (ESP).

degree2.desc: You gain one Master-degree ESP effect. You can also choose one power stunt you can perform with your ESP effects for –1 SP.
